in_hebrew.name: Henig
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Friend of the god Hephaestus
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Henig הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek 'Henos' meaning 'friend' and 'gaios' meaning 'god', the name Henig is believed to have been given in honor of Hephaestus, the Greek god of fire, blacksmiths, and craftsmen. The name is a testament to the close relationship between the bearer and the divine power.
